program.name: Agility 35
program.subject: Court & field sports
program.blurb: Thirty-five minutes of agility: an EMOM one day, a footwork circuit and legs the next.
program.about: Quick feet for about half an hour. One day is an EMOM of shuffles, cuts and first-step jumps, a set at the top of every minute; the other a footwork circuit, then leg strength for changing direction. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder variations.
program.split: Agility EMOM / footwork circuit & legs, 35 minutes
